Eli: Hey folks - quick enrollment question. My spouse is on an F-1 and just started OPT (got an SSN last week). Can I add them to my Redwood medical/dental during open enrollment even though their visa says student? Also do we need an SSN to enroll?
Dana (People Ops): Congrats on the SSN! Short answer: yes, being on OPT doesnt automatically disqualify them from being your spouse on the plan. Eligibility is based on relationship (marriage) and residency rules, not immigration status alone. We do ask for ID + evidence for enrollment.
Eli: Sweet. What exact docs should I upload so we don't get kicked back? Dont want delays.
BenefitsBot: KB: https://redwood.example.com/kb/benefits/international-spouse-enrollment - lists accepted docs and timelines.
Sam (Benefits): Steps to add your spouse:
1) Proof of marriage (marriage certificate).
2) Photo ID and passport pages that show name + visa stamp.
3) SSN card or ITIN if you have one (SSN speeds payroll and claims processing but ITIN is acceptable).
4) Proof of US residence (utility bill or lease) if they will be living with you.
5) If already employed/covered elsewhere, upload that carrier ID for coordination of benefits.
Sam (Benefits): Upload all to People Ops > Manage Dependents or directly at https://redwood.example.com/portal/dependents. Include a note "Eli / OPT spouse SSN". We typically process within 5 business days during open enrollment.
Eli: If we add them now and they depart the US for a month for family stuff, does coverage remain?
Dana (People Ops): Short trips are fine. Extended relocations may affect eligibility (residency rules). If they change primary residence abroad for more than 90 days, ping us with travel/assignment docs.
Sam (Benefits): Payroll: premiums will start on the effective date (usually first of next month after approval). Having an SSN prevents claims/payment delays; no premium discount just because theyre on OPT.
Eli: Got it. Uploaded marriage cert + passport + SSN screenshot. Thanks!
Sam (Benefits): Case #BP-8033 created. Well email confirmation and effective date once verified. :white_check_mark:
Eli: Awesome, appreciate it :pray:
